payload.description: Recovery doc docs/how-to/fix-fgos-write-rejected-merge-block.md's restore-paths-and-amend recipe is now impossible to execute on long-lived fgw/* branches forked before the events.jsonl log migration: merge.mjs's self-heal for stale-but-append-only-prefix .fgos/ drift only fires for paths tagged merge=union in .gitattributes, and that attribute was retired for events.jsonl by a recent unrelated change. Meanwhile .githooks/pre-commit's stagedFgosChangesOnWorkerBranch guard (tsk-5pb) now categorically refuses ANY .fgos/ change on ANY fgw/* branch commit in either direction, so the doc's own documented fix can no longer land. Discovered while recovering tsk-34o5 from repeated merge-conflict friction (workaround used instead: confirm the item's real commits never touch .fgos/, then git rebase main onto the item branch instead of merging, which drops the stale .fgos/ drift at the source). This will likely recur for the next long-lived branch that forked before the events.jsonl migration. Needs triage: either restore union-merge coverage for events.jsonl, or update the recovery doc's recipe to match the newer worker-branch write guard.
